scope.reason_candidate_v2_not_frozen: S9 passed independently under the any-order policy; the complete candidate-v2 contract still requires every S5-S9 scenario gate.

pre_fix_failures: S9 initially treated the three forced LEFT decisions as simultaneous completion and did not prove temporary physical formation dissolution or causal interaction with the bypass-lane actor.

The sampled S9 narrow-entry distance and speed were recorded but not consumed by the fixed-route spawn manager, so seed 59 placed the platoon too close to the c3 seam and forced the blocker geometry out of its sampled relation.
A generic IDM blocker at the c3 seam could follow its navigation branch across lane 0, contradicting the declared middle-lane obstruction role.
fixes: The S9 joint plan uses platoon-order start delays and distinct completion times while retaining all three real LEFT transitions and full joint safety audits.
The fixed-route spawn manager now consumes S9's deterministic ego_distance_to_narrow_entry_m and ego_initial_speed_km_h values, aligning physical spawn geometry with the memory parameters.
The blocking actor uses a scenario-specific lane-keeping policy, remains slow or stopped in c3 lane 1, and cannot turn across the bypass lane.

Persistent functional evidence now proves actor realization, causal bypass interaction, distinct LEFT completion times, completion clearance, blocker passage, narrow-road continuation, no return to lane 1, and post-bypass formation recovery.

artifact_validation.visual_review: Reviewed seed 59 top-down and semantic-BEV frames at 2, 5, 10, and 18 seconds. The middle-lane blocker, left-lane constraint actor, three physical LEFT transitions, longitudinal blocker passage, continued bypass-lane travel, and recovered ordering agree with the machine evidence; no collision, off-road motion, teleportation, route return, or silent actor loss was observed.
